name: cable standing neutral grip overhead triceps extension
description: Overhead cable extension with a neutral grip that loads the long head of the triceps through a deep stretch.
instructions: Attach a rope or neutral handle to a low pulley and face away from the stack.
Hold it overhead with elbows bent and pointing forward, one foot slightly ahead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your ribs down.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to a deep stretch and repeat.
